description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 
 
 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Job Description 
 Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced Agentic AI Systems Engineer to serve as an enterprise systems engineer for agentic AI within our Data, Analytics, and Insights – AI Innovation & Engineering organization. This role shapes how agentic AI is adopted across a large, global enterprise: you will assess use cases end to end, decide where to buy, build, or extend, and design the target architecture that lets agents work safely across our business systems. You have a proven track record of making sound technology investment decisions, designing integrated enterprise platforms, and guiding solutions from concept through production at scale. 

 This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. 

 Your Responsibilities 
 Serve as the architecture lead across a portfolio of agentic AI use cases, owning the technical specification, solution architecture, and delivery approach for each. 
 Lead buy vs. build vs. extend decisions for AI capabilities, evaluating vendor platforms, embedded AI features in existing enterprise applications (e.g., ERP, CRM, ITSM, productivity suites), and custom-built solutions against total cost of ownership, time to value, differentiation, risk, and long-term supportability. 
 Develop and maintain the enterprise Agentic AI / Orchestration reference architecture for agentic AI, including agent platforms, orchestration, tool and data access, identity, observability, and guardrails. 
 Define decision frameworks, architecture patterns, and reusable standards that help product teams choose the right approach consistently and reduce duplicated spend across functions. 
 Partner with AI Strategy, Product, Cybersecurity, Data & Analytics, Procurement, and business stakeholders to rationalize the AI application portfolio and identify consolidation opportunities. 
 Lead technical vendor evaluations, proofs of concept, and architecture reviews; translate findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership. 
 Provide perspective on resource needs, cost models, and delivery risk, and advise stakeholders on sequencing and investment priorities. 
 Champion responsible AI by embedding governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements into every architecture decision. 
 
 Key Technical Skill Expectations 
 Enterprise Architecture & Buy vs. Build Strategy: Apply structured methods (e.g., TOGAF, capability mapping, TCO and ROI analysis) to assess build, buy, partner, or reuse options, and document architecture decisions with clear trade-offs. 
 Agentic AI Systems Design: Architect AI agents that use tools and skills, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers, and design multi-agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, or Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols. 
 Platform & Vendor Landscape: Maintain a working knowledge of the agentic AI market, including hyperscaler agent platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks Agentbricks), SaaS-embedded agents, and open-source frameworks, and understand where each fits. 
 Enterprise Integration: Design how agents securely access enterprise systems and data, including ERP, CRM, PLM, and ITSM platforms, through APIs, event-driven integration, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines backed by vector and NoSQL stores. 
 System Architecture & Security: Design secure architectures for AI products that comply with enterprise data governance and security policies, including identity and access for agents, PII filtering, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 Operations, Observability & Cost: Define standards for AI deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and cost management (LLMOps/FinOps), leveraging containerization, infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform), and CI/CD on cloud platforms. 

 The Essentials - You Will Have 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 
 Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 
 
 The Preferred - You Might Also Have 
 Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience, including 3+ years in an enterprise or solution architecture role. 
 Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a similar discipline. 
 Demonstrated experience leading buy vs. build decisions and vendor selections for enterprise technology, including business cases and TCO analysis. 
 Hands-on experience designing and deploying Generative AI solutions, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent systems in production, regardless of the underlying cloud vendor. 
 5+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 Experience integrating with enterprise applications such as ERP (e.g., IFS Cloud, SAP), CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics 365), or ITSM (e.g., ServiceNow). 
 Proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern API, integration, and event-driven architecture patterns. 
 Enterprise architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF) or cloud architect certification (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional). 
 Familiarity with AI governance and risk frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001. 
 Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones. 
 Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. 
 
 What We Offer 
 Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision 
 401k 
 Paid Time off 
 Parental and Caregiver Leave 
 Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life 
 To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com 
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. 
 
 This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

 At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. 
 
 If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.
 
 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.
